turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why was my son's essay given a zero before anyone called me?
I don't think this is productive.
Productive would have been a phone call before the zero went in. Who decided to enter it, and before or after anyone spoke to Owen?
I'm going to go. I have a class in ten minutes.
Then you have ten minutes, Hale, and I'll use them. Was Owen spoken to before that zero went in, yes or no? If not, I'm going to the principal's office when you walk out.
Email the principal if you want. I'm done here.
I will. But you're the one who entered a zero, so tell me what you have besides a score, because right now I'm hearing nothing.
